title: P0.82: Scope resource-pressure gates for explicit external consultation
description: Allow explicit external consultations to proceed under HIGH resource pressure while continuing to block only CRITICAL pressure and defer heavy nonessential metacognitive work.
reason: Live Windows proof on 2026-06-01 showed ChatGPT intent was correctly detected and CDP was available, but the dispatch ended as blocked_by_resource_pressure. The resource gate was too broad: it blocked the user-facing external consultation instead of only budgeting heavy background work.
next_action: Run a live ChatGPT consultation from the desktop shortcut. Expected: no local fallback, no resource_pressure block for HIGH pressure; terminal may be response_captured or an actionable security/session handoff.
resume_hint: P0.82 changes consultation quiescence and AutonomyGovernancePolicy: HIGH pressure permits explicit external consultation; CRITICAL pressure still blocks/defer; heavy background work remains governed separately.
